about: Required Claude Code plugins/skills per person. scripts/skills.py installs + verifies them; hooks block code edits until the gate is GREEN. Change only through a PR (both approve).

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.why: TDD (red-green-refactor), systematic debugging, verification-before-completion, writing/executing plans, code-review discipline (obra/superpowers, MIT)

plugins.name: pyright-lsp
plugins.why: Python diagnostics + go-to-definition in terminal sessions (needs pyright-langserver)

plugins.name: jdtls-lsp
plugins.why: Java diagnostics for ledger + gateway (needs jdtls)

plugins.name: typescript-lsp
plugins.why: TypeScript diagnostics for the console (needs typescript-language-server)

plugins.name: pr-review-toolkit
plugins.why: Specialized review agents (code, silent failures, tests, types) — Om approves every PR

plugins.name: security-guidance
plugins.why: Reviews Claude's own edits for vulnerabilities — Om owns the security boundary and the CI workflows

plugins.name: differential-review
plugins.why: Security-focused diff review with blast-radius estimate, used inside /review-pr (Trail of Bits)

plugins.name: insecure-defaults
plugins.why: Finds fail-open defaults, hardcoded credentials, weak auth — enforces the fail-closed rule (Trail of Bits)

plugins.name: mcp-server-dev
plugins.why: MCP server patterns for the MCP adapter (OM-06)

plugins.name: frontend-design
plugins.why: Distinctive, accessible UI for the review console (OM-21/22)

plugins.name: document-skills
plugins.why: docx/pdf/pptx/xlsx for the final report and demo deck (source-available: install, never copy)

vendored_skills.name: langgraph-fundamentals
vendored_skills.why: Current LangGraph StateGraph / Command / streaming patterns (official LangChain skill; nested so it loads only in services/agent)

vendored_skills.name: langgraph-persistence
vendored_skills.why: Checkpointers + interrupts: resume by run_id and approval waits (KG-08)

binaries.hint: curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash   (the VS Code extension alone may not put `claude` on PATH)
WSL: sudo apt install git · macOS: xcode-select --install
WSL: sudo apt install gh · macOS: brew install gh
npm install -g pyright   (no Node? uv tool install pyright)
make skills-install BIN=1   (Eclipse JDT LS → ~/.local/bin/jdtls; see docs/team/SKILLS.md §4)

commands.hint: gh auth login   (in YOUR terminal — Claude never sees the token)
